newsitem.title: UK: Runaway UK bishop to marry, apologises to church.
newsitem.headline: Runaway UK bishop to marry, apologises to church.

text.p: A Roman Catholic bishop from Scotland who caused an uproar by running away with a divorcee broke cover on Tuesday to apologise to the church and to announce he would marry his lover.

It was the first time Roderick Wright, formerly the Bishop of Argyll, had appeared in public since his sudden resignation and disappearance a month ago. His lover, mother-of-three Kathleen Macphee, watched as he read out a prepared statement.

"We are in love and intend to marry, but at this moment we are living from day to day and we do not yet know when that will be," Wright told reporters outside a holiday cottage in the northwestern lakeside resort of Kendal.
"Our main sadness and pain is at what we have caused in the lives of others...We both wish we had handled things very differently," said Wright.

"We wish to apologise, especially to our families who have suffered so much, not only because of the manner of our leaving, but because of the intense pressure placed upon them by the media," he said.

Wright's case caused huge embarrassment in the Catholic church when it emerged that he had a 15-year-old son by another woman. He further enraged Church authorities by selling his story to a tabloid newspaper for a reported 300,000 pound ($470,000) sum.
Wright offered apologies to the Catholic church in Scotland and to his fellow priests and parishioners. "Our message to them is heartfelt sorrow for the sadness and pain caused," he said.

Wright's apology failed to impress Catholic church authorities. "We have absolutely nothing to say about the situation regarding the former Bishop Wright since he has not been in contact with this office," said spokesman Tom Connelly.
The couple told the Glasgow Herald newspaper in an interview earlier they would probably get married at a civil wedding.
Wright said he would have to accept after 32 years as a priest that he would never stand at an altar again and say mass.
Macphee said the couple had sex only after they had run away together. "People can't seem to understand that we could have a loving relationship without sex, but we did," she said. ($1=.6401 Pound)
